verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const files=["app/discover/page.tsx","app/(marketing)/about/page.tsx","app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx","app/(marketing)/start/page.tsx"];const bad=[];for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync(f))process.exit(79);let d=path.dirname(f),hasCard=false;while(d&&d!=="app"&&d!=="."){if(fs.readdirSync(d).some(e=>/^opengraph-image\./.test(e)))hasCard=true;d=path.dirname(d)}if(hasCard)continue;const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const i=s.search(/openGraph\s*:\s*\{/);if(i<0)continue;let j=s.indexOf("{",i),depth=0,k=j;for(;k<s.length;k++){if(s[k]==="{")depth++;else if(s[k]==="}"){depth--;if(depth===0)break}}const block=s.slice(j,k+1);if(!/\bimages\s*:/.test(block))bad.push(f)}if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-798: "+bad.join(", ")+" declare openGraph without images and have no segment card below app/, so their share previews ship no og:image or twitter:image.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: lib/site.ts exports ROOT_OG_IMAGES (the root 1200x630 card with its alt text); the 31 pages and layouts under app/ whose openGraph block had no images and no segment card spread it, pageContentMetadata and listingMetadata fall back to it when the row has no image of its own, and scripts/check-metadata-images.test.ts now fails any openGraph literal under app/ that lacks images where no opengraph-image file would supply them, next to the LIVE-141 test that fails the opposite.
